target_customer: Product, design and research teams at companies that run user research
problem: User research is slow and costly to recruit, interview and analyze.

founders.name: Siddhartha Javvaji
previous_startups: Postlet (listed on YC page as co-founder and CEO, outcome not found)
founders.background_notes: AI research at Stanford HAI per YC page.

founders.name: Pratham Hombal
founders.background_notes: High performance computing research and hackathon wins per YC page.

technical_complexity.rationale: Voice or chat interview agents plus recruiting and synthesis are standard LLM engineering with some hard parts around quality.

defensibility.rationale: Many funded entrants with similar workflows and no proprietary panel or data was found.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Listen Labs raised a 69M Series B in January 2026 and Strella a 14M Series A, so better funded rivals grew quickly.

market_need_then: Teams wanted faster qualitative insight, and AI interview startups were raising seed rounds in 2024 and 2025.

branding.domain_note: Uses trystratify.com, a try prefix, not the exact .com.

identity.voice_and_tone: Plain and benefit oriented per YC copy

branding.community_and_virality: Product Hunt launch in May 2025 with a comment asking whether interviews are real people.

brand_strength.rationale: Name is shared with several other companies called Stratify, causing confusion in funding data.

outcome_analysis: Stratify launched its AI user researcher in May 2025 as a two person Stanford team. No funding announcement, customer figures or outcome news were found, and the market is led by better funded rivals. There is not enough public evidence to call it a success or a stall.
notes: VCBacked lists about 500K pre-seed in June 2025 with YC, single aggregator, unverified, not recorded as a round. CB Insights 4.9M seed and Finextra relate to a different company called Stratify. Company website fetch was blocked by a rate-limited safety check, so site content was not read. Founded year not stated in sources opened.
